spot.observation_cutoff: OKX provider event time 2026-11-11T23:56:13.061Z; Kraken event time not supplied
spot.interpretation: Asynchronous venue observations. Kraken does not provide an event timestamp in the captured response. The normalized midpoint difference is a data-quality/dislocation flag, not executable arbitrage.

orderbook.last_prior_snapshot: Fuelmaps six-venue 14:00 UTC snapshot from Run38; stale at Run39 cutoff, resting/cancellable liquidity, excludes Binance and Bitget

funding.binance_context: CryptoQuant figure relayed by Coinpedia/CryptoTicker; highest since October 2025 per those reports. Underlying CryptoQuant series was not independently fetched in this run.
funding.okx_window: settlements back to 2026-10-09; not exactly a calendar 30-day window
funding.independence_note: CryptoTicker and FundJu both rely on OKX public funding data for OKX history; they are not independent exchange datasets. Binance CryptoQuant is a separate venue/dataset but was not directly retrieved.

open_interest.source: CryptoTicker report using OKX public data
open_interest.limitation: USD OI decline includes mark-price decline; coin-denominated OI reportedly contracted less. Account ratios are not notional exposure.

etf_flows.nov3_to_nov6: four consecutive zero-net-flow trading days reported
etf_flows.source_lineage: SoSoValue data relayed by CryptoTicker/Coinpedia and 24/7 Wall St. These articles share the same underlying flow source; not independent confirmations.
etf_flows.scope_warning: Other trackers report different fund cohorts, cutoffs and reconstructed holdings-change flows. Do not average with the separate Alpha/XRP Insights universes.

evernorth_resale_filing.company_resale_proceeds: none, except cash proceeds if sponsor warrants are exercised
evernorth_resale_filing.eloc_registration: separate registration statement; do not combine with the 73,688,162-share resale registration
evernorth_resale_filing.xrp_effect: This is registration of potential shareholder securities resales/conversions, not evidence of completed share sales or an Evernorth XRP sale. Share supply/dilution can affect XRPN equity and XRP-per-share calculations without directly changing the XRP wallet.

secondary_market_context.caveat: Temporal association with the resale filing is not proof of causation. The article itself identifies Bitcoin weakness, ETF flows and the preceding market decline as competing explanations for XRP's move.

stolen_xrp_wallet_reconciliation.source: CryptoTicker report citing Elliptic and XRPL ledger data
stolen_xrp_wallet_reconciliation.ellipitic_reported_route: Most transferred XRP was swapped into BTC through THORChain
stolen_xrp_wallet_reconciliation.limitation: Ledger transfers and swaps do not identify ultimate buyers or prove fiat cash-out. A reduction in the attacker's concentrated balance is not proof of net market buying or price support.

identity_and_exact_phrase_research.actual_capital: No standardized XRP metric or primary-source definition established. Continue separating cash raised, cash deployed to purchase XRP, in-kind XRP, debt, facilities, collateral, registered resale capacity and secondary sales.
identity_and_exact_phrase_research.ask_coin: Current search surfaces Permission Coin ASK and unrelated ASK candidates. Permission Coin is reported as an OFT-20 on Base and Polygon; no XRPL/XRP integration verified. Search results are not proof of a direct XRP relationship.
identity_and_exact_phrase_research.sbic_chatgpt: Official Tokyo SBIC training material lists ChatGPT/Copilot education; SBIC West's 2024 seminar material is also educational. No OpenAI strategic partnership or formal 'SBIC, ChatGPT SBIC' entity/relationship verified.
identity_and_exact_phrase_research.kamilah_camilla_stevenson: No first-party YouTube channel ownership verification in this run. No personal video inventory attributed. Camilla and Kamilah are not assumed to be the same person.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive cumulative funding and a 3.7 OKX long/short account ratio amid a large price decline indicate persistent leveraged long crowding and potential liquidation sensitivity.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Positive funding can also arise from basis/carry trades or hedged exposure; USD OI fell partly because XRP's mark price fell; OKX account ratios are not notional positioning.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Nov9 ETF outflow may have been concentrated in Bitwise rather than a broad institutional exit.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The five-fund cohort and rolling/cumulative windows differ across providers; later Nov10 flows and other fund universes may tell a different story.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Evernorth resale registration may pressure XRPN equity valuation through potential shareholder supply and conversion dilution.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No completed resales are established; Evernorth receives no resale proceeds; the registration does not itself sell XRP or change the treasury wallet.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The attacker's remaining XRP concentration was reduced after the dormant wallet transfer and subsequent THORChain routing.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The ultimate buyers and cash-out path are unknown; the 29.47M XRP collection balance remained at the reported cutoff and subsequent transfers were not verified in this run.

competing_hypotheses.claim: A cross-venue spot dislocation may have emerged between OKX XRP-USDT and Kraken XRP/USD.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Quotes are asynchronous; Kraken event timestamp is absent; top-of-book sizes are limited; no synchronized L2/trade sequence was captured.
